Sign catalogue

Sign

M150

Looks like: an X but drawn in outline

From the field-cady sign descriptions (Parpola 256). This describes the picture, not the meaning: a sign that looks like a fish may stand for a sound or another word.

Wells W692 · Opener

Appears in 53 texts (63 uses), mostly on seals at Mohenjo-daro; usually starts a text. In the larger ICIT corpus its Wells equivalent W692 is in 66 texts, including at Banawali.

Project finding: Validated opener: starts texts Held up

Where it appears 53

Counts are distinct texts in the Mahadevan 1977 concordance (a text repeated on many moulded tablets counts once). 61 objects in all carry it.
